info.title: Friends' Arena
info.description: Anonymous rooms. HTTP uses bearer room tokens. WebSockets authenticate in the first frame; see ClientMessage and ServerMessage schemas.

101.description: Per-room WebSocket. Authenticate first, then Start or Move. Receives personalized Snapshots and Errors.

Action.description: A command tagged with the ruleset that understands it.

Card.description: A standard playing card; ranks run from two (2) to ace (14).

ClientMessage.description:
Send Authenticate as the first text frame within five seconds. Subsequent
commands carry the latest observed Snapshot revision. Moves may be queued
behind other moves in the same game and are revalidated against current state.

Config.description: Setup options tagged with the ruleset that defines their `GameConfig` struct.

CrazyEightsGameConfig.description: Optional rank effects; eights are always wild. All options default to false.

CrazyEightsPendingDraw.description: A draw-two obligation: aces permit an ace response; twos do not stack.

oneOf.description: Internal replay command, submitted through the room's host-only finish command.

CrewColor.description: Printed colors; black is the trump color.

CrewDeclaration.description: A statement about a card relative to its owner's current hand.

GameConfig.description: Empty serializable configuration for games without optional rules.

GameKind.description: A registered ruleset and its serialized game identifier.

Membership.description: Keep the token private. It grants control of this seat, including after reconnecting.

Outcome.description: A finished result with optional scores in seat order.

scores.description: Optional final scores; each ruleset determines how they rank.

winners.description: Winning seats; empty for a draw, or multiple seats for a shared win.

Record_Action_Event.description: One accepted action and the ordered effects it produced.

action.description: A command tagged with the ruleset that understands it.

oneOf.description: A player performed an accepted action.
A player captured pieces from the board.
The current play pile was removed from the game.
A matching column was removed from a player's layout.
The session reached its final outcome.

items.description: Common rule effects that the included games can record without exposing cards.

events.description: Rule effects, followed by a terminal event when the game ends.

player.description: The seat that submitted the action.

Replay.description: Includes hidden information; only share after the game has ended.

oneOf.description: Explicit setup options; absent from version-1 files.

game.description: The ruleset needed to interpret the history.

players.description: The number of seats present at setup.

records.description: Accepted commands and their expected effects in execution order.

seed.description: The original seed, sufficient to reconstruct hidden card order.

version.description: Rules revision; must match the selected game's supported version.

acknowledged.description: True only for the submitting socket's successful command response.

ShitheadGameConfig.description: Whether four matching cards may bypass the ordinary rank restrictions.

can_finish.description: Whether this seat may record a shared result for the current game.

Suit.description: One of the four standard playing-card suits.

cards.description: Only face-up cards have values, including in the viewer's own row.

hand_counts.description: Counts of this viewer's unrevealed cards, without their positions.

Turn.description: Eligible seats and a ruleset-managed turn counter, not a room revision.

number.description: The number of turn advances since setup.

players.description: The seats that may act next; this is not a queue or priority order.

View.description: A player's observation tagged with its ruleset.
